subject: POC intake and prompt/log deliverables — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Sharma <aditi@lexiconhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir@lexiconhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:15:00Z
Subject: POC intake and prompt/log deliverables — next steps

Hi Aditi / Samir,

Thanks again for the time this morning — great to learn more about Lexicon Health's use case for clinical notes summarization and the priority of reducing reviewer hours on the triage team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for the POC: 

Summary of what we heard
- Goal: 90% reviewer agreement on priority tags and a 40% reduction in average reviewer time per case.
- Primary data: clinician notes + triage annotations (existing review tags).
- Constraints: must not retain PHI in Redwood-hosted evaluation artifacts; redacted or tokenized logs preferred.

Requested deliverables for POC evaluation
1) Representative prompt set: ~1,000 prompts across triage categories (mix of short/long notes). JSONL preferred (one prompt/line) with an id and gold label.
2) Raw/processed logs sample: up to 5,000 rows (CSV) with columns: note_id, note_text (redacted), reviewer_label, timestamp, source_system. If redaction is incomplete, please mark fields that may contain PHI.
3) Success criteria doc: a quick list of measurable pass/fail metrics (e.g., label accuracy >= 0.90, latency p95 < 500ms, reviewer time reduction >= 30%).

Operational asks
- How would you prefer to transfer data? We can accept an S3 bucket (preferred), secure share via Okta-approved transfer, or a temporary Google Drive folder restricted by link.
- Please share the contact for your engineering/data lead so our data-ops engineer can coordinate access and validate sample formatting.
- If Lexicon requires a DPA or specific redaction assurances before data moves, please loop in your legal contact.

Proposed timeline
- Sample delivery: by 2028-08-10
- Initial ingest & eval plan draft: by 2028-08-17
- First POC run: week of 2028-08-21

If that all looks reasonable I will loop in Monica (POC ops) and Karthik (solutions lead) to own ingestion and eval design.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
--

- Success criteria: we like your suggested metrics. I will draft a one-pager baseline and share by next Wednesday.
